agencies.name: Spokane Transit Authority

gtfs_rt.notes: Shared key published in STA's own public OneBusAway configuration, not a private credential issued to this project. Review docs/STA_INTEGRATION.md's Compliance section before any public deployment -- spokanetransit.com sits behind Cloudflare, which is why this reads the raw GTFS-RT endpoint directly instead of the usual OneBusAway JSON layer.

agencies.gtfs_static_source: https://database.mobilitydata.org -- the Mobility Database's public, unauthenticated mirror of STA's GTFS. spokanetransit.com's own static feed sits behind the same Cloudflare protection as its live one, so this project doesn't read it directly.
agencies.stop_code_convention: The numeric code printed on the physical stop sign.
